question: In recent days, in the wake of the conflict that has flared up in the Middle East following the US and Israeli attack on Iran and Iran’s subsequent response, the European fishing fleet has seen fuel prices skyrocket to almost double pre-conflict levels. All of this is leading professionals in the sector to leave their boats moored, or to consider doing so, since the rising cost of fuel has made fishing unprofitable.

In view of the above: What measures does the European Commission intend to take — via EMFAF, state aid, market measures, etc. — to tackle the rise in fuel prices and mitigate the impact of this crisis on the activity of the European fishing fleet and ancillary sectors?
